text: When the agent writes a plan, everyone can read the whole of it, not only its diff, while the session goes on.
When the agent works on an OpenSpec change, a plan card appears at the top of the timeline: its title, a button for each document, and how many tasks are done.
Each document opens in a tab next to the terminal. Its top links the plan's other documents, so you can go from the proposal to the design.
Every Markdown file the agent writes is in Files, under Documents, too.
The task count follows along live. When the agent changes a document you read, its button says changed.
Open it again, and the parts that changed since you last read it are marked New or Changed. Turn Highlight changes off to read without the marks.
Switch to Source to see the Markdown as written, with line numbers, and the same parts marked line by line.
Read the plan while the agent works, and see what changed since you last looked.
